reply_text:
*One merge-blocking finding*

*P1 — Overlapping imports aren’t deduplicated by ID* — `src/dedupe.js:2`
`new Set(contacts)` compares object references, not contact IDs. Separate objects with the same ID survive, so `mergeImports` retains duplicates—the main case this branch is meant to handle.

Verified: merging `[{id: 1, name: 'Ada'}]` with `[{id: 1, name: 'Ada updated'}]` returns both contacts, instead of keeping only the first as specified in `README.md:5`.

*Recommended fix:* Track seen `contact.id` values and retain only the first contact per ID. Add a regression test using distinct objects with the same ID, including across two import lists.

All 4 existing tests pass; `test/dedupe.test.js` only tests repeated references and distinct IDs, so it misses this case. No other findings. No files changed.
